response_text: {"operations":[{"primitive":"REPEAL","doc_ids":["DOC-efd07f","DOC-62e3e2"],"evidence_quote":"Operating Guidelines for Small Finance Banks were issued vide Circular DBR.DOC-62e3e2 dated October 6, 2016 , which prescribed, inter alia, broad indicative guidelines in areas related to Financial Inclusion and Development. In continuation with the same, comprehensive set of guidelines in the form of a compendium is Annexed .","rationale":"The compendium supersedes and consolidates the Financial Inclusion and Development guidelines earlier prescribed in the Operating Guidelines."},{"primitive":"MERGE","doc_ids":["DOC-551b6f","DOC-efd07f"],"evidence_quote":"A comprehensive set of guidelines for Small Finance banks in the form of compendium were published on our website on July 6, 2017. The guidelines issued under Chapter II of the compendium have been incorporated in this [consolidated reference].","rationale":"The compendium guidelines are folded into the consolidated instrument."},{"primitive":"RESOLVE_CROSS_REFERENCE","doc_ids":["DOC-551b6f"],"evidence_quote":"The [consolidated reference] enclosed incorporates the updated guidelines/ instructions/ circulars on the subject.","rationale":"Cross-references to individual circulars are replaced by the consolidated text."},{"primitive":"RESOLVE_CROSS_REFERENCE","doc_ids":["DOC-4bf73d"],"evidence_quote":"As per extant guidelines, lending by Small Finance Banks (SFBs) to Micro-Finance Institutions (MFIs) for on-lending is not reckoned for priority sector lending (PSL) classification.","rationale":"The reference to extant guidelines should be replaced with the consolidated PSL text."},{"primitive":"RELATE_OBLIGATION","doc_ids":["DOC-4bf73d","DOC-5a351b"],"evidence_quote":"it has been decided to allow PSL classification to the fresh credit extended by SFBs to registered NBFC-MFIs and other MFIs (Societies, Trusts etc.)","rationale":"The SFB on-lending PSL dispensation and the long-term bond PSL pre-emption relief are parallel PSL obligations kept distinct."},{"primitive":"ELEVATE_GENERAL_RULE","doc_ids":["DOC-62e3e2"],"evidence_quote":"These Operating Guidelines are supplementary to the Licensing Guidelines and take immediate effect.","rationale":"The supplementary-and-effect instruction is a recurring rule suitable for a general part."},{"primitive":"CANONICALIZE_DEFINITION","doc_ids":["DOC-4bf73d"],"evidence_quote":"which have a ‘gross loan portfolio’ of upto ₹500 crore as on 31 March 2021, for the purpose of on-lending to individuals","rationale":"A single definition of 'gross loan portfolio' should replace divergent usages."}]}
